title: DTRA official collecting documents on extraterrestrials

tellings.quote: person in charge of collecting all of the information from Ditra dealing with extraterrestrials and as he put it quote unquote little green men happened to sit next to me at my computer terminal and began pulling all the documents on my system and the systems in our skiff.

plain: An unnamed speaker says that the official in charge of gathering everything the Defense Threat Reduction Agency, a Pentagon agency that deals with weapons threats, held on extraterrestrials, "little green men" as the official put it, sat down at the speaker's computer. The speaker says the official pulled every such document off that machine and off the systems in their secure room for classified work. The speaker tells it as something they saw.
